subject.title: Add typed Project Record composed block

question: Should the generic blocks package retain the Project Record composed-block API, or should this portfolio-oriented composition remain consumer-owned?
rationale: The change introduces a durable public block contract, while repository policy requires generic package boundaries and explicit Bobby approval before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the generic block
options.body: Approve the package-level contract and require redacted editor-to-SSR proof for the exact implementation before merge.

options.title: Keep it consumer-owned
options.body: Decline the package API and retain only reusable primitives in this repository while moving the composition to a consumer site.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic block
recommendation.body: Approve the package-level contract and require redacted editor-to-SSR proof for the exact implementation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy names Bobby as the explicit merge approval authority for this package.
